scope: Research systems analysis and experimental design only; no production integration
recommendation_not_to_confuse: 80 techniques and 80 bibliography records coincidentally have same numeral but are unrelated inventories

techniques.name: ADC to Rs
techniques.proposed_change: Implement calibrated circuit-specific ADC-to-volts and Rs with RL, voltage dividers, ADS1115 gain, sample/heater timing; propagate component uncertainty.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Require device wiring and raw ADC/voltage/RL trace.

techniques.name: R0 calibration
techniques.proposed_change: R0 per sensor instance, gas reference, heater phase, ambient and age; forbid borrowing from paper/model; retain questionable table values.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Replicated standards and traceable blank, heater-cycle metadata.

techniques.name: Sensitivity curves
techniques.proposed_change: Source-tag manufacturer curves and alternative graph fits; normalize ppm and output-scale units; avoid extrapolation and correlated curve priors.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Source chart digitization audit and independent pure-gas points.

techniques.name: Heater cycles
techniques.proposed_change: Separate manufacturer-defined MQ7/MQ9 heater duty profiles from exploratory thermal excitation on approved hardware; forbid arbitrary PWM.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Electrical manufacturer compliance and per-phase Rs traces.

techniques.name: Environmental correction
techniques.proposed_change: Conditioned environmental compensation with BME humidity/temperature/pressure and out-of-support detector; do not remove chemical trend.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Factorial humidity/temperature reference exposures.

techniques.name: Signal quality
techniques.proposed_change: Model intake/dead volume/fan duty/flush and sensor response delay as physical sampling state; QC contamination and carry-over.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Measured chamber airflow/washout/retained-sample tests.

techniques.name: Drift monitoring
techniques.proposed_change: Online device health diagnostics only, independent of training drift compensation in 07.5.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Longitudinal blank and reference checks on same devices.

techniques.name: Filtering
techniques.proposed_change: Compare robust noise suppression to transient-preserving filters; fit filter solely on train data.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Show preserved onset times/area and group-holdout effect.

techniques.name: Scaling
techniques.proposed_change: Retain source-aware scaling and prohibit test-fold normalization leakage; unit-aware Rs vs ADC separation.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Per-source baseline and grouped split tests.

techniques.name: Static features
techniques.proposed_change: Retain ratios, peaks, slope and recovery features with source-specific units.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Whole recorded event held out.

techniques.name: Temporal features
techniques.proposed_change: Add segmental average differentiation, phase-dependent response, kinetic slope and causal deconvolution features.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Time-shift ablation, independent full trials.

techniques.name: Fingerprints
techniques.proposed_change: Separate molecule/pure-reference fingerprints from mixture/food/odor class, source-transfer and device-specific features.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Enforce class semantics and leave source/session out.

techniques.name: 3D/4D features
techniques.proposed_change: Keep 3D/4D models as exploratory features and bounded simulation, not independent chemistry evidence.
techniques.acceptance_gate: No fabricated measurements; compare on matched actual traces.

techniques.name: Feature selection
techniques.proposed_change: Add train-only stability selection, nested sensor ranking and cost/energy-aware feature parsimony.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Nested validation with whole sessions/devices.

techniques.name: Provenance schema
techniques.proposed_change: Formal source and label ontology: gas versus complex sample, ppb/ppm, Ri/R0/RL, calibration provenance, exposure group and train/test ancestry.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Automated schema and audit-of-raw-file checks.

techniques.name: PCA
techniques.proposed_change: PCA for exploratory visualizable structure only; no standalone gas certainty.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Train-only fit and heldout projection.

techniques.name: Similarity
techniques.proposed_change: Density/shape-aware similarity with instrument response uncertainty and source group.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Candidate-ranking calibration after grouped holdout.

techniques.name: Class overlap
techniques.proposed_change: Quantify pure-gas and binary mixture overlaps under concentration and ambient shifts.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Report indistinguishable regions and abstention.

techniques.name: LDA/PLS-DA
techniques.proposed_change: Retain genuinely trained LDA/PLS-DA external implementation; ensure cross-fold PLS components chosen train-only.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Compare complete heldout protocol to documented baseline.

techniques.name: Sensor importance
techniques.proposed_change: Channel ablation and sensor-specific gain with hardware stability; no universal sensor rank across instruments.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Repeated nested ablation, cost-accuracy trade-off.

techniques.name: Sensor subsets
techniques.proposed_change: Design minimum MQ subsets robustly across gases and concentration rather than all-eight assumption.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Evaluate source subsets across heldout sessions and gas levels.

techniques.name: Concentration confounding
techniques.proposed_change: Joint concentration-invariant feature checks and leave-concentration-out stress; distinguish concentration change from identity change.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Locked unseen concentration ranges and per-gas confusion.

techniques.name: Identifiability limits
techniques.proposed_change: Measure mixture observability: response Jacobian rank, condition number and non-identifiable component combinations.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Show when composition cannot be uniquely inferred with given sensors.

techniques.name: Curve matching
techniques.proposed_change: Only curve-match within source-referenced calibration domain with heater, RL and R0 per device; treat unmatched as unknown.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Independent standard reference and uncertainty.

techniques.name: Fingerprint matching
techniques.proposed_change: Use validated source-labelled fingerprints and report source-specific transfer domain.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Grouped cross-source OOD and top-k.

techniques.name: KNN
techniques.proposed_change: KNN simple baseline; train-only feature extraction/scaling.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Paired heldout vs richer models.

techniques.name: Logistic regression
techniques.proposed_change: Logistic baseline with calibration and group splits.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Reference comparisons and uncertainty.

techniques.name: SVM
techniques.proposed_change: True linear/RBF SVM research implementation; tune nested, do not claim Tank transfer.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Grouped source validation.

techniques.name: Random Forest
techniques.proposed_change: Random forests/ExtraTrees with class imbalance and uncertainty; separate concentration from identity target.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Nested source and concentration groups.

techniques.name: XGBoost
techniques.proposed_change: Real XGBoost reference path exists; compare learning curve and leakage hazards.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Grouped holdout and freeze hyperparameters.

techniques.name: MLP
techniques.proposed_change: MLP/BP baseline must be actually trained and compared with penalized simpler methods.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Independent gas class trials.

techniques.name: Physics+ML
techniques.proposed_change: Forward molecule+sensor+environment QSPR with source-specific response curves, then candidate-wise inverse ranking; no true-label descriptors; physics regularization.
techniques.acceptance_gate: MQ135-only source test and heldout-molecule challenge; calibrated candidate error.

techniques.name: Benchmarking
techniques.proposed_change: Frozen benchmark registry: pure gas, mixtures, OOD, source and device; nested tuning, independent final test; record failed methods.
techniques.acceptance_gate: No windows of same exposure in both train/test.

techniques.name: Single-sensor calibration
techniques.proposed_change: Device/gas-specific monotonic single-sensor concentration regression with traceable R0 definition; no paper R0 transfer.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Certified target gas concentrations over range.

techniques.name: Multipoint calibration
techniques.proposed_change: Multi-point and factorial temperature/humidity calibration with hysteresis, dilution uncertainty and concentration-specific error.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Replicate standards, uncertainty budget, environmental conditions.

techniques.name: Nonlinear regression
techniques.proposed_change: Physical nonlinear log-sensitivity models, saturation and cross sensitivity with meaningful bounds.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Independent multi-concentration mixtures.

techniques.name: Multisensor regression
techniques.proposed_change: True constrained multicomponent inverse regression with nonnegative concentrations and physically valid sensor response equations.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Known each-component ppm; report per-gas RMSE/MAE and ambiguity.

techniques.name: PLS regression
techniques.proposed_change: Real PLS/PLS2 and MCR-ALS latent profiles, rank and nonnegativity under explicit assumptions.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Unseen mixture compositions and independent time batches.

techniques.name: Tree regression
techniques.proposed_change: RF/ExtraTrees/CatBoost/SVR regression candidates with uncertainty and concentration/domain limits.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Paired per-component evaluation, no leakage.

techniques.name: Identity-conditional estimates
techniques.proposed_change: Identity-conditioned concentration only when identity confidence passes scientific gate; allow unknown and mixtures.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Quantification error conditional on label quality.

techniques.name: LOD/LOQ
techniques.proposed_change: Detection power/LOD/LOQ from blank and independently measured standards under humidity/noise, not manufacturer cartoon threshold.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Calibration blank distribution and false-negative confidence.

techniques.name: Unseen concentrations
techniques.proposed_change: Concentration extrapolation stress and defined out-of-range rejection instead of unbounded ppm.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Heldout concentration strata, out-of-domain alarm.

techniques.name: Evidence fusion
techniques.proposed_change: Evidence fusion with dependence graph across same MQ curve, QSPR priors and ML; prohibit double counting correlated evidence.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Ablation + reliability diagram and source-separated error.

techniques.name: Bayesian inference
techniques.proposed_change: Bayesian ranking over candidate gas and concentration with priors and unidentifiability flag.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Posterior calibration and coverage on unknown gas.

techniques.name: Probability calibration
techniques.proposed_change: Probability calibration on calibration fold only; no on-the-fly confidence as measured ppm.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Expected calibration error on session holdout.

techniques.name: Conformal prediction
techniques.proposed_change: Conformal sets with group/shift qualifications; report loss of exchangeability across devices.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Coverage per device/domain, empty set counted as abstention.

techniques.name: Open-set recognition
techniques.proposed_change: Open-set candidate rejection with class-sequestered training and unknown categories.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Heldout chemical species, not random rows only.

techniques.name: OOD detection
techniques.proposed_change: OOD checks spanning new chemical, concentration, drift and ambient/device.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Distinct OOD axes and false-safe rates.

techniques.name: Evidence conflicts
techniques.proposed_change: Evidence conflict accounting for cross-sensitivity and physically impossible concentration/mixture combinations.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Disagreement with mixture standards and abstain.

techniques.name: SHAP
techniques.proposed_change: SHAP and descriptive model diagnostics only; do not label explanation as causal chemistry.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Feature importance stability and false explanatory claims.

techniques.name: Abstention
techniques.proposed_change: Decision policy for unknown gas, unknown mixture, unsupported ppm and sensor fault; fail-safe separate from research identity.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Thresholds from decision costs, grouped false-negative confidence.

techniques.name: Cross-session tests
techniques.proposed_change: Session-level validation distinct from time windows.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Entire exposure and recording groups separated.

techniques.name: Cross-device tests
techniques.proposed_change: Cross-device alignment with device-specific R0 and domain adaptation, not cross-device shared R0.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Hold out physical sensor modules.

techniques.name: Cross-concentration tests
techniques.proposed_change: Train/holdout disjoint concentration ranges, not nearby windows.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Report errors at unseen ppm and power dependence.

techniques.name: Drift detection
techniques.proposed_change: Change-point drift detection conditional on environment and history.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Longitudinal independent days.

techniques.name: Drift compensation
techniques.proposed_change: OSC/PLS drift correction constrained against removing chemistry signals.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Before/after heldout calibration and interferents.

techniques.name: Domain adaptation
techniques.proposed_change: Domain adaptation with unsupervised target normalization and no target-label leakage.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Test later batches and unseen instruments.

techniques.name: Transfer learning
techniques.proposed_change: Transfer learning from non-MQ allowed only method-wise, unless physically mapped MQ channel.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Zero-shot vs few-shot device transfer claims separated.

techniques.name: Active learning/DoE
techniques.proposed_change: Use active design-of-experiments over gases, ppm, binary mixtures, temperature, RH, phase, session and device.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Pre-registered factorial/space filling and random effects.

techniques.name: Continual learning
techniques.proposed_change: No uncontrolled model self-update in deployed field app; require governance and fresh independent revalidation.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Locked model and separate training signoff.

techniques.name: Resource profiling
techniques.proposed_change: Profile actual Android CPU, battery and stream latency vs algorithms; do not infer from desktop tests.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Device runtime profiling, memory and thermal test.

techniques.name: 1D-CNN
techniques.proposed_change: Conv1d real external baseline already trained; test actual MQ temporal before deployment.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Session/device-heldout; compare simpler feature models.

techniques.name: TCN
techniques.proposed_change: Causal TCN real external baseline; maintain temporal causality.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Streaming prefix invariance on heldout sessions.

techniques.name: LSTM/GRU
techniques.proposed_change: GRU exists on main and LSTM on separate draft PR; treat both as research-only.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Read PR #3, LSTM external 59/90 and GRU 69/90; Tank unknown.

techniques.name: GNN
techniques.proposed_change: GNN prototype underperforms simpler external baselines; do not prioritize without meaningful sensor graph and gains.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Controlled graph ablations on sufficient Tank data.

techniques.name: Temporal ensemble
techniques.proposed_change: Temporal ensemble must be diversity-aware with correlated model error and honest uncertainty.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Pairwise error dependence, no naive vote confidence.

techniques.name: Simulation
techniques.proposed_change: Source-calibrated kinetics and flow/heat time constants, no synthetic coefficient masquerading as measured.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Fit actual bounded response/recovery curves; PR #3 prototype not merged.

techniques.name: Sim-to-real
techniques.proposed_change: Correct time alignment, units, sensor identity, baseline, impedance and domain shift before sim-real comparisons.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Paired physical apparatus and source trace hashes.

techniques.name: Mixture detection
techniques.proposed_change: Separate binary/ternary mixture detection and mixture-presence OOD from exact constituent identification.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Whole mixed runs, unseen ratios and absent compounds.

techniques.name: Unmixing
techniques.proposed_change: Introduce model families MCR-ALS, nonnegative/sparse constrained inversion and nonlinear cross-sensitivity; explicitly test identifiability.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Pure-gas and measured binary mixture ground-truth with abundance per component.

techniques.name: Multi-analyte regression
techniques.proposed_change: Multi-output gas-specific ppm regression with mass-flow setpoints and uncertainty; classification not surrogate for concentration.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Each constituent ppm error on heldout mixtures and external sessions.

techniques.name: Interference
techniques.proposed_change: Separate chemical hardware filtering/preconcentration from computational interference model and purge; account breakthrough/humidity and target loss.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Filter-before/after and bleed-through under standards; no ad hoc heated addon.

techniques.name: Complex products
techniques.proposed_change: Food/liquid/wood/composite fingerprints trained as classes only; avoid gas molecule labels.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Holdout physical specimen and sample origin.

techniques.name: Robotic olfaction
techniques.proposed_change: Define robotic olfaction assumptions and recording pose/time/wind before claiming localization.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Time synchronized pose+wind+gas data.

techniques.name: Gas mapping
techniques.proposed_change: Build gas occupancy field when spatial reference route exists, not from stationary chambers.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Ground truth release positions and wind.

techniques.name: Source localization
techniques.proposed_change: Estimate source position only with transport dynamics, wind and reference source geometry.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Cross-plume trials with measured flow.

techniques.name: Active sampling
techniques.proposed_change: Active sampling as controlled experiment: adjustable intake, clean-air purge, pauses and motion; maintain time-lag aware data model.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Measured sample delay, pump/fan phases and normalized chamber mixing.

techniques.name: Spatiotemporal fusion
techniques.proposed_change: Combine aligned robot pose plus time series after wind and inlet impulse response are available.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Independent field plume campaigns.

techniques.name: Motion decisions
techniques.proposed_change: Motion-to-source safety and gas map decision policy requires validated source cues; movement safety remains independent.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Safe navigation + independently verified plume orientation.

techniques.name: Negative Evidence & Sensor-Guided Exclusion
techniques.proposed_change: Negative evidence only with calibrated detector sensitivity/false negative under concentration, mixture and humidity; forbid exclusion from non-response alone.
techniques.acceptance_gate: Species-conditional detection power, unknown-class caution.

prioritized_program.reason: Mixed manufacturer graph curves and inconsistent externally borrowed R0 make quantitative outputs unsafe
Mixture class ≠ gas-by-gas concentrations, rank-limited inverse systems and cross sensitivity
Source labels, double counting and calibrated uncertainty/abstention need shared contracts
PubChem descriptors need measured sensor forward training and inverse candidates rather than true-label leakage
Physical sampling/flow/heater and temporal transport are missing from practical input design
Feature selection, drift and experiment design need proper independent source comparisons

prospective_techniques_not_approved.name: Physical selective sample conditioning (molecular-sieve/filter/bypass)
prospective_techniques_not_approved.why_not_immediate: No filter/bypass physical module in Tank and published filtered SnO2 devices not equivalent to MQ cartridges
prospective_techniques_not_approved.criterion_for_new_technique: Controlled inlet filter-versus-bypass multi-gas benchmark with independently measured loss/breakthrough and a distinct control interface

prospective_techniques_not_approved.name: PubChem/QSPR-driven open-universe compound hypothesis retrieval
prospective_techniques_not_approved.why_not_immediate: Only studies on JPL polymer-carbon and custom MOS, without demonstrated improvements on physical Tank MQ8
prospective_techniques_not_approved.criterion_for_new_technique: Forward calibrated MQ data plus molecular holdout and quantitatively significant incremental top-k/OOD benefit without test-label leakage

prospective_techniques_not_approved.name: Metrological provenance and uncertainty budget executor
prospective_techniques_not_approved.why_not_immediate: Cross-cutting QA framework rather than new gas-classification algorithm
prospective_techniques_not_approved.criterion_for_new_technique: Traceable real calibration trace chain and independent acceptance of quantified uncertainty and detection limits

prospective_techniques_not_approved.name: Temporal deconvolution and online mixture-change tracking
prospective_techniques_not_approved.why_not_immediate: Existing dynamic-feature/kinetic modeling stages can host the prototype
prospective_techniques_not_approved.criterion_for_new_technique: Demonstrated source-specific inverse dynamics across heldout changes with uncertainty and stable causal operation

dependency_map: 04 and 05 parallel qualitative and quantitative candidate models
09 mapping after spatial flow reference; stage 10 calibrated non-detection separate from alarms
holdout_constraints: No random slicing of time series from same exposure
No test-label molecule descriptor injection into candidate inference
No treating one binary mixture trajectory as millions of independent exposures
No single nominal R0 from paper applied to Tank physical modules
Mixture identity accuracy not substitute for independently measured per-gas ppm errors
No unsupported thermal PWM on physical MQ7/MQ9
